en.quote: …[the universal electronic card] will be issued from January 1, 2012 through December 31, 2013, inclusive, upon citizens’ applications.
en.head: The card rollout on application began a year late.
en.body: The original plan promised cards on application from January 2012. In December 2012, St Petersburg authorities announced a January 2013 start under the then-current federal rules, a one-year delay. The legal chapter governing the cards was repealed effective January 1, 2017, ending issuance. The quotation makes no claim about issuing 120 million cards.

osrc.t: Law No. 210-FZ, Chapter 6 repealed effective January 1, 2017
St Petersburg administration, notice of 2013 card rollout
